description:
Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team!

 Who We Are
 Johnson Controls is powered by your talent. Together, we're building a world that's safer, more comfortable, and more sustainable. Our global team develops innovative technologies and intelligent solutions that help transform buildings, cities, and critical infrastructure around the world.

 What We Offer
 Competitive salary
 15 days of vacation in your first year, plus paid holidays and sick time
 Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k), available on day one
 Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
 Collaborative and innovative team environment
 Commitment to safety through our Zero Harm culture
 
 What You Will Do
 As an Embedded Software Engineer I, you will help develop the embedded software that powers Johnson Controls' next generation of intelligent building technologies. Working closely with software, firmware, controls, hardware, and systems engineering teams, you will contribute to products that improve building performance, connectivity, and user experience.
 Learn more about our engineering organization: Johnson Controls Advanced Development and Engineering Center (JADEC) 

 How You Will Do It
 Develop high-quality, secure embedded software solutions for building equipment and controls.
 Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to ensure seamless integration across hardware, firmware, controls, and software platforms.
 Participate throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, implementation, testing, and validation.
 Support software architecture, troubleshooting, debugging, and continuous improvement initiatives.
 Contribute to the development of innovative features and connected product capabilities.
 Promote engineering best practices and a collaborative team culture.
 
 Location: New Freedom, PA (Onsite). Relocation provided. 

 What You Will Need

 Required Qualifications
 Must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without current or future sponsorship. 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
 2+ years of embedded software development experience. Recent graduates with relevant internship or co-op experience are encouraged to apply.
 Experience developing software in C and/or C++.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 Familiarity with software development tools such as Git and Jira.
 
 Preferred Qualifications
 Experience with LabVIEW, MATLAB, and/or Simulink.
 Experience with HVAC, air handlers, chillers, heat pumps, or other electromechanical control systems.
 Exposure to embedded Linux, RTOS, or connected device development.
 
 SALARY: $71,000 - $94,000 (Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.) This position includes a competitive benefits package. The posted salary range reflects the target compensation for this role. However, we recognize that exceptional candidates may bring unique skills and experiences that exceed the typical profile. If you believe your background warrants consideration beyond the stated range, we encourage you to apply. To support an efficient and fair hiring process, we may use technology assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help identify and evaluate candidates. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers. For details, please visit the About Us tab on the Johnson Controls Careers site at About Johnson Controls Careers .
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Johnson Controls International plc. is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a qualified individual with a disability or any other characteristic protected by law. To view more information about your equal opportunity and non-discrimination rights as a candidate, visit EEO is the Law . If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit here .
